_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Unacheza Golf (Mchezo wa Kadi) - Mchezaji {player_id}.
Lengo: Pata jumla ya alama ndogo katika raundi hii moja. Ikiwa safu wima zina thamani sawa, zinaongezwa kama 0.
Thamani za Kadi: A=1, 2-10=thamani ya uso, J/Q=10, K=0

Vitendo (tumia mabano sahihi):
- '[draw]' - Chora kutoka sitaha ya kadi
- '[take]' - Chukua kutoka pundo la kadi zilizotupwa
- '[swap X Y]' - Badilisha kadi iliyochorwa na nafasi X (safu) Y (safu wima)
- '[discard]' - Tupwa kadi iliyochorwa

board.drew:
Umechora: {card}
Sasa unahitaji [swap X Y] au [discard]
board.took:
Umechukua: {card} kutoka kwenye mfuko wa kutupwa
Unahitaji [swap X Y] nayo (hauwezi kutupa)

options.final_turns: Dhum mwalo! Chaguo zako: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Uzidi: [swap X Y] (hudhihi kadi kutoka pundo la kadi zilizotupwa)

message.deck_empty: Sitaha ya kadi imekwisha! Mchezo unaisha mara moja.
message.knocked: Jalo {pid} ogoyo! Ng'ato ka ng'ato kuom jotugo mamoko yudo thuolo achiel.
message.final_round: Mwani {pid} {reason}! Kila mwani mwingine anapata mzunguko mmoja zaidi

invalid.wrong_action: Tijwo kutumia timbe moja tu: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], au [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Ine un tijwo kwanza [draw], [take], [knock], au [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Ok inyal wito kad ma ne ogol e pile mar gik miwito oko. Nyaka ilokne machielo.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Ine un kadi koro. Ine un tijwo [swap X Y] au [discard] kadi.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Nafasi imepita mipaka. Tumia safu 1-{max_row}, safu wima 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Udhihogi kugonga na kadi iliyochorwa. Maliza zamu yako kwanza.
